item.title: Trump aims to leave a physical legacy in D.C., bulldozing norms along the way
item.description: President Trump has brought his New York real estate background to the White House. But experts say D.C. is a very different historic and legal landscape — and worry about the precedent he could set.
item.content:encoded: President Trump has brought his New York real estate background to the White House. But experts say D.C. is a very different historic and legal landscape — and worry about the precedent he could set.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Treisman

item.title: 5 men arrested over suspected attack at a U.S.-run air force base are British nationals
item.description: Authorities have arrested five British nationals over a suspected attack at a U.S.-operated air force base in England. The men, all in their 20s from London, were detained Sunday.
item.content:encoded:
Authorities have arrested five British nationals over a suspected attack at a U.S.-operated air force base in England. The men, all in their 20s from London, were detained Sunday.

(Image credit: Alastair Grant)

item.title: 'End Times Fascism' looks at supremacist groups uniting around end-of-the-world ideas
item.description: Authors Naomi Klein and Astra Taylor identify supremacists that have, despite ideological differences, converged around the conviction that they are part of an elite destined to survive an apocalypse.

item.title: A new anti-ICE compilation album benefits immigrants rights organizations
item.description: The Contra-ICE Vol. 1: ICE OUT album features contributions from over 30 artists, including Kathleen Hanna, Fred Armisen and Tom Morello to create a historical and artistic record of this moment.

item.title: Welcome to the 'Wild West' of AI in schools: Research is scarce, but experiments abound
item.description: Teachers are using AI to develop lesson plans, and in some districts, AI chatbots give students feedback on their work. Meanwhile, the research around how AI can help students is extremely limited.

item.description: President Trump announced plans to cancel $810 million in Congressionally approved spending, a move that some in his own party are calling illegal.

item.description: D.C.'s Rat Rangers take anyone who is interested on night time safaris through some of the Capitol's filthiest back alleys to learn the way of the rats, and to be better humans.

item.title: 5 tips for parents worried about their kids' screen time and online safety
item.description: Parental monitoring can help protect kids from the harms of social media and excess screen time. Screen time boundaries plus early and open conversations about online habits can make kids less vulnerable.

item.title: Mexico's Baja California braces for Hurricane Polo as Hurricane Nolo threatens Hawaii
item.description: Hurricane Nolo edged further away from the Hawaiian Islands on Sunday as major Hurricane Polo bore down on Mexico's Baja California peninsula with a threat of storm surge, high winds and heavy rains.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Eviction of 87-year-old sparks protests in Madrid over housing crisis
item.description: Tens of thousands marched through Madrid on Saturday to protest Spain's housing crisis and the eviction of an 87-year-old woman, camping overnight in Madrid's historic Puerta del Sol plaza.
